Interpretation: CWM Log10 Seed Mass is moderately negatively associated with FDis and RaoQ across all 90 plots.
The negative Seed Mass association persists after accounting for Habitat, Zone, and Habitat × Zone structure.
The negative association remains strong after removing Habitat × Zone cell means, indicating that it is not explained only by between-cell differences.
CWM Log10 Seed Mass remains a significant negative correlate of functional dispersion after simultaneous adjustment for Habitat × Zone and the other three CWM traits.
Wood Density, SLA, and Maximum Height show weaker or non-robust associations with functional diversity compared with Seed Mass.
